body.statement: Let \(\mathsf D\) be one fixed non-anticipating design. First, if \(P,Q\in\mathcal P_{\beta,\alpha}^{\mathrm{HM}}\) induce the same observed trajectory law under \(\mathsf D\), and \(s_a^{P,\mathsf D}(x)>0\) for \(P_X\)-almost every \(x\) and both \(a\in\mathcal A\), then \(\theta(P)=\theta(Q)\). Conversely, suppose there are \(a\in\mathcal A\), \(x_0\in\mathcal X\), \(r_0\in(0,1/2)\), and \(\eta>0\) such that the positive-uniform-mass set \(B=\{x:\|x-x_0\|_\infty<r_0\}\) is contained in \(\mathcal X\), \(\Delta_\dagger+\eta\le2M\), and \(\eta r_0^{-\beta}\le L\). Suppose \(\mathsf D\) assigns arm \(a\) with probability zero whenever the current context lies in \(B\), for every round and every observed history, and \(\mathbb E_{X\sim\operatorname{Unif}(\mathcal X)}[\psi_{x_0,r_0}(X)\{a\pi_0(X)+(1-a)(1-\pi_0(X))\}]>0\). Define \(P\) and \(Q\) to have uniform contexts and conditionally independent Gaussian innovations with the common scale \(\sigma\). Under both laws the mean of arm \(1-a\) is \(M\); the mean of arm \(a\) is \(M-\Delta_\dagger\) under \(P\) and \(M-\Delta_\dagger-\eta\psi_{x_0,r_0}(x)\) under \(Q\). Because the declared parameter domains give \(c_X\le1\le C_X\), the uniform density obeys the same envelope, so \(P,Q\in\mathcal P_{\beta,\alpha}^{\mathrm{HM}}\), \(\mathbb P_{P,\mathsf D}^{T}=\mathbb P_{Q,\mathsf D}^{T}\), and \(|\theta(P)-\theta(Q)|=\eta\mathbb E_{X\sim\operatorname{Unif}(\mathcal X)}[\psi_{x_0,r_0}(X)\{a\pi_0(X)+(1-a)(1-\pi_0(X))\}]>0\).
body.justification: The two directions distinguish genuine observed-law identification from irreducible ambiguity created by an adaptive design that never reveals a benchmark-relevant arm on a positive-mass region.
body.gap: LuedtkeVanDerLaan2016OptimalValue studies optimal value as an observed-data functional under a supplied observation law, while adaptive-policy inference papers impose positivity for fixed-policy scores; neither gives an observational-equivalence construction tied to history-dependent zero exposure and the benchmark-relative targeting gain.
body.consumer: The result gives the frontier a sharp information boundary: attaining designs must create exposure wherever the benchmark makes the suppressed arm relevant, and no interval rule based only on the trajectory can repair a violated boundary.
